say:1:1435405001:1.text: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...
say:1:1435405001:1.source_cn: 那些矮人看得太紧了，我根本没空去摸那些机械……
say:1:1435405001:1.male: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...
say:1:1435405001:1.female: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...

choice_prompt:2:1435405001.text: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...
choice_prompt:2:1435405001.source_cn: 那些矮人看得太紧了，我根本没空去摸那些机械……
choice_prompt:2:1435405001.male: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...
choice_prompt:2:1435405001.female: The dwarves are watching way too closely, I haven't had a chance to get a proper look at their machines...

say:3:1435405002:1.text: Shhh! Keep it down! Getting in here wasn't exactly easy, you know.
say:3:1435405002:1.source_cn: 嘘，小点声，我跑到这可不容易！
say:3:1435405002:1.male: Shhh! Keep it down! Getting in here wasn't exactly easy, you know.
say:3:1435405002:1.female: Shhh! Keep it down! Getting in here wasn't exactly easy, you know.

say:4:1435405003:1.text: Can't you tell by how I look? I'm an Essail, from Sal'thorin.
say:4:1435405003:1.source_cn: 你看我样子还不知道？我是艾塞勒，从萨洛克兰跑出来的。
say:4:1435405003:1.male: Can't you tell by how I look? I'm an Essail, from Sal'thorin.
say:4:1435405003:1.female: Can't you tell by how I look? I'm an Essail, from Sal'thorin.

say:5:1435405004:1.text: I told the dwarves I was with the Lightbearers, here to inspect their machinery!
say:5:1435405004:1.source_cn: 不过我骗那些矮人我是耀光来的，要考察他们的机械！
say:5:1435405004:1.male: I told the dwarves I was with the Lightbearers, here to inspect their machinery!
say:5:1435405004:1.female: I told the dwarves I was with the Lightbearers, here to inspect their machinery!

say:6:1435405005:1.text: Unfortunately, turns out a few of them actually know what they're doing. Saw right through me and locked me up.
say:6:1435405005:1.source_cn: 结果没想到碰上几个懂行的，居然看穿了，还把我关了起来。
say:6:1435405005:1.male: Unfortunately, turns out a few of them actually know what they're doing. Saw right through me and locked me up.
say:6:1435405005:1.female: Unfortunately, turns out a few of them actually know what they're doing. Saw right through me and locked me up.

say:7:1435405006:1.text: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!
say:7:1435405006:1.source_cn: 不是说矮人分不清我们的长相吗！那七个混蛋！
say:7:1435405006:1.male: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!
say:7:1435405006:1.female: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!

choice_prompt:8:1435405006.text: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!
choice_prompt:8:1435405006.source_cn: 不是说矮人分不清我们的长相吗！那七个混蛋！
choice_prompt:8:1435405006.male: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!
choice_prompt:8:1435405006.female: Aren't dwarves supposed to think we all look the same?! Curse those seven fools!

say:9:1435405007:1.text: What? Oh! They showed me a red fruit to identify, and I couldn't. Turns out it was an apple!
say:9:1435405007:1.source_cn: 啥？哦！他们就是拿一个红色的果子让我认，我没认出来……...
say:9:1435405007:1.male: What? Oh! They showed me a red fruit to identify, and I couldn't. Turns out it was an apple!
say:9:1435405007:1.female: What? Oh! They showed me a red fruit to identify, and I couldn't. Turns out it was an apple!

say:10:1435405009:1.text: Tch. A little setback like that won't stop me. The beauty of machinery calls to me!
say:10:1435405009:1.source_cn: 哼，一点小小的阻碍，根本不会影响我继续探寻机械之美的道路！
say:10:1435405009:1.male: Tch. A little setback like that won't stop me. The beauty of machinery calls to me!
say:10:1435405009:1.female: Tch. A little setback like that won't stop me. The beauty of machinery calls to me!

say:11:1435405010:1.text: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.
say:11:1435405010:1.source_cn: 早晚有一天，我也要成为一个出色的机械师！
say:11:1435405010:1.male: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.
say:11:1435405010:1.female: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.

choice_prompt:12:1435405010.text: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.
choice_prompt:12:1435405010.source_cn: 早晚有一天，我也要成为一个出色的机械师！
choice_prompt:12:1435405010.male: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.
choice_prompt:12:1435405010.female: One day, I'll be a top-tier engineer. Just you wait.

say:13:1435405011:1.text: What are you talking about? These dwarves have taste! They don't make sparkly little trinkets.
say:13:1435405011:1.source_cn: 你在说什么啊，这里的矮人很有品味的，才不会铸造那些亮闪...
say:13:1435405011:1.male: What are you talking about? These dwarves have taste! They don't make sparkly little trinkets.
say:13:1435405011:1.female: What are you talking about? These dwarves have taste! They don't make sparkly little trinkets.

say:14:1435405012:1.text: They build monuments! Machines that rumble, clang, and explode with life!
say:14:1435405012:1.source_cn: 这里的一切都充满了机械的美！巨大！粗犷！轰隆隆！
say:14:1435405012:1.male: They build monuments! Machines that rumble, clang, and explode with life!
say:14:1435405012:1.female: They build monuments! Machines that rumble, clang, and explode with life!

say:15:1435405013:1.text: Alright, alright, enough chit-chat. Go on, don't blow my cover. I still need to sneak another peek at that conveyor belt...
say:15:1435405013:1.source_cn: 好了好了，聊完了就快点走吧，别耽误我的潜伏！我还要找机...
say:15:1435405013:1.male: Alright, alright, enough chit-chat. Go on, don't blow my cover. I still need to sneak another peek at that conveyor belt...
say:15:1435405013:1.female: Alright, alright, enough chit-chat. Go on, don't blow my cover. I still need to sneak another peek at that conveyor belt...

say:17:1435405008:1.text: What? Oh! They locked me in a tower, but it was built for dwarf height so I got out easily!
say:17:1435405008:1.source_cn: 啥？哦！他们就是把我关在一座塔上，但那是以矮人身高修建...
say:17:1435405008:1.male: What? Oh! They locked me in a tower, but it was built for dwarf height so I got out easily!
say:17:1435405008:1.female: What? Oh! They locked me in a tower, but it was built for dwarf height so I got out easily!

choice:8:1:2.text: Were you the one in that tower?
choice:8:1:2.male: Were you the one in that tower?
choice:8:1:2.female: Were you the one in that tower?
